description: Submits up to 50 sitemaps for one property in a single call, reporting success or failure per entry. The API has no batch method — this makes the calls one after another — but it saves a round trip per sitemap, which is what makes a large site practical. One failure does not stop the rest.

feedpaths.description: The full URLs of the sitemaps to submit

site_url.description: The Search Console property: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or "https://example.com/" for a URL-prefix property (the trailing slash is required)

name: submit_sitemaps

truncated.description: Present only when entries were dropped to fit the budget.
